items.title: Head refuses to read too much into Bangladesh's warm-up woes
items.summary: The visitors were bundled out for just 54 in their second innings to suffer an innings and 38-run defeat in Darwin.

items.title: ‘A plan for every batter’: Taskin trusts his process against Australia batters
items.summary: The series also carries personal significance for Taskin, who grew up watching Australian cricket and its legendary fast bowlers. Now, he has the opportunity to face them on their home soil.

items.title: Taskin 'honoured' to play Test series in Australia, 14 years after first visit
items.summary: Bangladesh played their only Test series in the country in 2003

items.title: WTC race gathers pace, Australia in command
items.summary: Australia, the runners-up in the last edition, currently sit comfortably at the top of the standings after winning seven of their eight Tests. South Africa and New Zealand are also well placed, while Bangladesh remain in contention after a promising start to their campaign.

items.title: 'Don't worry about it': Steve Waugh’s classy gesture to Bangladesh
items.summary: The Australian captain could not change the gulf between the two teams. He could, however, make sure Bangladesh knew that they had earned their place at the table.

items.title: Bangladesh's road to 2027 ODI World Cup all but certain
items.summary: Bangladesh are all but certain to qualify directly for the 2027 ODI World Cup after Afghanistan’s 92-run win over Ireland in the second ODI of their five-match series on Friday -- a result that also left West Indies on the brink of having to play the qualifiers.

items.title: Borson's fifer helps Bangladesh Emerging side thrash SA counterparts in final's dress rehearsal
items.summary: Bangladesh Men's Emerging side thrashed South Africa Emerging by eight wickets at Irene Villagers Cricket Club in Pretoria on Sunday to win the dress rehearsal ahead of Wednesday's final.

items.title: 'We let ourselves down' - worries increase for Simmons after tour-game collapse
items.summary: Taijul Islam, who had picked up an injury while batting in the tour game and did not bowl at all, is expected to be fit in time for the first Test

items.title: Bangladesh fold for 54 in Test warm-up as Thompson takes 8 for 25
